mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_role_menu(role_id, menu_id, created_at, created_by) VALUES(#{roleId}, #{menuId}, #{now}, #{actorId})
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT rm.menu_id FROM sys_role_menu rm JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = rm.role_id JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 'ENABLED'
